column1: Optional Challenge: Challenge the listener. We're talking unexpected sounds/timings/progressions/inter-genres, whatever devices you can think of to keep the listener questioning their musical reality. Break their expectations and the satisfaction they derive from sustained order, make them accept the inevitable decay of all systems into disorder.
column5: Optional Challenge: Benn is going to DJ all the tracks together live at the listening party! So be prepared for your track to be mixed in randomly, intro/outros won't necessarily be played in full and maybe part of your track will have other bits mixed over the top. 160 BPM in the Key of F is a strong suggestion, but if you deviate Benn will probably still find a way to mix it in. As a bonus, write your track using sounds from this free 500 soundfonts collection: https://archive.org/details/500-soundfonts-full-gm-sets
column9: This month we interrupt our regularly scheduled song submissions... We're looking for ~15 second clips/loops/samples! Then Benn is going to make a track out of them on stream for the listening party. Probably stick to 120 BPM in A. It doesn't have to be coherent, submit a chord sequence, some noises, something you've sampled, a drone, a base line, vocal line, whatever! 2 submissions max per person so this doesn't turn into a 2 hour sample listening party.
column13: Optional challenge: The samples you submitted last month are now available for download! If you use them please give credit.
